sloka: गन्गा यमुनयोह् पुण्यात् सम्गमात् आह्Rतम् जलम् ।अयं पृच्छामि वचनात् सुखमायुष्मतामहम् ॥२-१५-१८॥
transliteration: gangā yamunayoh puṇyāt samgamāt āhRtam jalam ।ayaṁ pṛcchāmi vacanāt sukhamāyuṣmatāmaham ॥2-15-18॥

translations.english: On your behalf I shall enquire from the king who is awake now about his welfare and the reason for calling me here.
